f.title: Specify in detail the safety-critical elements (e.g. vital-sign and blood-chemistry monitoring) in Phase I protocols
f.statement: Phase I protocols must primarily provide an outline of the investigation (estimated number of patients, safety exclusions, dosing plan including duration, dose or methods to determine the dose) and must specify in detail only those study elements that are critical to safety, such as the necessary monitoring of vital signs and blood chemistry.
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by Disposición ANMAT 7516/2025 (from 1 Dec 2025). Phase I clinical pharmacology study protocols submitted to ANMAT under Disposición 6677/10 as amended by Disposición 4008/2017. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Los protocolos de Fase I deben estar dirigidos fundamentalmente a proveer un esquema de la investigación —estimación del número de pacientes a ser incluidos, descripción de las exclusiones por seguridad, la descripción del plan de dosificación incluyendo la duración, la dosis o los métodos para ser utilizados para determinar la dosis— y deben especificar en detalle solamente aquellos elementos del estudio que sean críticos para la seguridad, tales como el monitoreo necesario de los signos vitales y la química sanguínea.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deben' = Mandatory; superseded by Disp. 7516/2025 (noted in applicability). 11.2 (site facilities/SOPs) and 11.3 (investigator duties) checked: they bind the research centre and investigator, not the sponsor/MAH, and concern Phase I site infrastructure rather than PV reporting, so no rows added. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "deben" = Mandatory. Below 90: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline; the sponsor actor is inferred (the quote binds "los protocolos").
rows.quote_en: Phase I protocols must be directed mainly at providing an outline of the investigation (estimate of the number of patients to be included, description of the exclusions for safety, description of the dosing plan including duration, dose or methods to be used to determine the dose) and must specify in detail only those elements of the study that are critical for safety, such as the necessary monitoring of vital signs and blood chemistry.

f.title: Describe dose-escalation and withdrawal criteria, safety evaluation and control methods, and risk assessment and contingency plans in Phase I protocols
f.statement: In particular, the Phase I protocol must clearly describe the dose-escalation criteria and volunteer withdrawal criteria, the methods for evaluating and controlling safety during the study, and the risk assessment analysis and contingency plans.
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by Disposición ANMAT 7516/2025 (from 1 Dec 2025). Phase I clinical pharmacology study protocols submitted to ANMAT under Disposición 6677/10 as amended by Disposición 4008/2017. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.quote: En particular el protocolo debe: - Describir con claridad los criterios de incremento de la dosis y los criterios de retiro del voluntario. - Describir los métodos para la evaluación y control de la seguridad durante el estudio. - Describir el análisis de evaluación de riesgo y los planes de contingencia.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'debe' = Mandatory; three bullet duties kept together as one protocol-content duty. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "el protocolo debe" = Mandatory. Below 90: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline; the sponsor actor is inferred (the quote binds "el protocolo").
rows.quote_en: In particular the protocol must: - Clearly describe the dose-escalation criteria and the volunteer withdrawal criteria. - Describe the methods for the evaluation and control of safety during the study. - Describe the risk assessment analysis and the contingency plans.
